finalText:
**Found it.** `engine.js` was rounding the USD total to 2 decimals after the percent coupon, and again after the flat coupon, before converting to the order's currency. That mid-calculation rounding lost fractions of a cent that only showed up once converted — hitting GBP, CAD, and JPY carts, always when a percent coupon (`SAVE10PCT`) was stacked.

Fixed by letting the discount math run in full precision and rounding only once, at the very end, in the target currency's own decimal places — same as finance's own reference calculation.

Tests: 40 pass, 0 fail, 0.1s (was 10 failing, all involving a percent coupon).
